spec.title: Trajectory Overview
spec.description: All trajectories in the current repeated Session.

spec.query: {span.state_lane_id =~ "experiment=${experiment}/${session}/traj=.*" && span.experiment_name =~ "${experiment}" && span.project =~ "${project}" && span.global_steps = ${step} && span.turn >= 0 && resource.service.name="rl_insight_monitor"} | select(span.turn, span.finish_reason)

spec.title: Task Summary
spec.description: One row per task episode in the current session.

spec.query: {span.monitor.trace_source = "task" && span.state_lane_id =~ "experiment=${experiment}/${session}/traj=.*" && span.experiment_name =~ "${experiment}" && span.project =~ "${project}" && span.global_steps = ${step}} | select(span.task_name, span.status, span.reward, span.accuracy, span.finished, span.reward_posted, span.error)

{span.monitor.trace_source = "session" && span.state_lane_id =~ "experiment=${experiment}/${session}/traj=.*" && span.experiment_name =~ "${experiment}" && span.project =~ "${project}" && span.global_steps = ${step}} | select(span.runner_name, span.status, span.num_trajectories, span.reward_source, span.finished)

spec.title: Turn details
spec.description: Each row is one turn: type, tools, finish reason, and content (thought, or response if thought is empty).

spec.query: {span.state_lane_id =~ "experiment=${experiment}/${session}/traj=${traj}" && span.experiment_name =~ "${experiment}" && span.project =~ "${project}" && span.global_steps = ${step} && span.turn >= 0 && resource.service.name="rl_insight_monitor"} | select(span.turn, span.type, span.tools, span.finish_reason, span.content, span.prompt_tokens, span.completion_tokens)
